verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a few self-running product mechanisms. Scheduled Rollouts gradually deploy a feature over time without further action, Autotune automatically reallocates traffic toward the winning variant, and Infra Analytics alerts catch regressions. These are narrow, feature-specific automations rather than a general background-automation or agentic workflow capability. CLI use in CI/CD is a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a general-purpose user-configurable automation/workflow engine, triggers/schedules beyond rollouts, autonomous agent-driven background tasks, independent corroboration.
